text:
Alice M: quick heads-up — saw a bunch of invoice-preview diffs today where charges were attributed to the default route even though the proxy had a route_tag. console preview shows missing route breakdown for ~1.2% of requests.
Bob J: ok. do we know whether the tag was stripped upstream or lost during enrich? any logs?
Alice M: early evidence points to the edge proxy not propagating our internal X-Route-Hint header for some clients (mobile SDKs). e.g. requests coming from older client versions lack the header, but the proxy also seems to be rewriting route headers in a couple of cases.
Carol S: console impact: the per-route cost card aggregates by route_id, but if we fall back to default route we inflate default's numbers and the invoice preview shows drift vs ledger. Customers notice.
Dave L: proposal: add an optional X-Redwood-Metering header carrying route_hint and plan_id. proxy will forward if present. backend enrich will prefer header over resolver when header exists. backwards compatible: if header absent, use resolver as today.
Frank (Console): careful — the console's preview pipeline expects route resolution to be idempotent. If we start honoring header only for some traffic, dashboard timeseries may jump during rollout. We need a canary and an explicit flag to surface: "route_hint_used" so preview marks those points.
Gina (Finance): accuracy first — even if it causes a blip, we need correct attribution for enterprise tenants. but also want low-noise rollout so biz doesn't get spammed.
Eden P: UX ask — can the console show a small banner on invoice preview when we detect mixed-attribution during rollout? "Some usage attributed via client route hints: may differ from historic attribution." toggleable.
Bob J: questions: 1) header format? 2) security/forgery? 3) rollout plan?
Alice M: header proto (suggestion):
```json
X-Redwood-Metering: route_hint=rt:us-west-123;plan_id=ent-pro-42;proto_ver=1
```
Only allow signed hints for high-tier customers? maybe HMAC with tenant key header: X-Redwood-Metering-Sig
Dave L: we should accept unsigned hints for low-trust sources but mark them as untrusted in telemetry. signed hints (HMAC) win over unsigned. the resolver remains authoritative if no header.
Carol S: telemetry additions: add boolean route_hint_present, route_hint_signed, route_hint_used. console filter by these so we can compare numbers.
Frank (Console): will add a special overlay to preview graphs and a toggle to include/exclude hinted-attribution. need a small API change in the preview endpoint: ?include_hinted=bool
Dave L: rollout plan I propose:
- step 1 (canary): edge proxy config enabled in canary region for 1% traffic. parse header, emit telemetry only, do NOT change invoice attribution.
- step 2 (soft): 25% of traffic — honor signed hints for enterprise tenants only; emit diffs in preview and an alert if delta > 2% for any tenant.
- step 3 (full): all traffic — honor signed or unsigned hints (unsigned flagged). add migration doc + CLI to backfill events where needed.
Eden P: timeline? we need a 7-day canary with dashboards and an opt-in toggle in console for customers to preview.
Gina (Finance): add a reconciliation report for any tenant where preview delta > $500 in a day during canary. ops alert to billing team.
metering-bot: [automated] sample event emitted: {ts:7681230300, tenant:acme, route_hint_present:true, route_hint_signed:false, route_resolver:default, hint_used:false}
Bob J: test matrix — unit tests for header parsing, integration tests for proxy passthrough, e2e for invoice preview delta. add fuzz test for malformed header.
Dave L: infra work: proxy change + small parser lib (go) + enrich service changes + preview api flag + console overlay. estimate: proxy+parser 2w, enrich+telemetry+tests 1.5w, console changes 1w -> parallelized.
Frank (Console): I'll open the preview PR and wire the overlay. linking draft: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/9999|console PR#9999>
Dave L: will open platform PR for header parsing: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/12345|PR#12345>
Alice M: agreement? we need explicit signoff from security on HMAC key handling before step 2.
Carol S: ops checklist: dashboards (per-tenant diff card), reconciler alert, a small backfill job spec.
Gina (Finance): SGTM for the plan. please include an embargoed customer comms draft for enterprise customers prior to step 2.
Eden P: I'll add the UX banner copy and the opt-in preview flow.
Dave L: I'll start a canary runbook and schedule a 7-day window starting Mon. will post runbook link when ready.
Alice M: thanks everyone — please add any follow-ups inline here. I'll track action items.
Bob J: small follow-up — can we add a metering lint rule to fail CI on malformed route hints reaching the proxy?
Dave L: yes, good idea. will add.
Frank (Console): logging note — include sample_id in preview logs so we can correlate events to the canary batch.
Alice M: ok wrapping — action owners: Dave (platform PR + runbook), Frank (console overlay PR), Carol (dashboards + telemetry spec), Gina (reconciliation/finance alerts), Eden (UX copy + opt-in flow), Bob (tests + lint), Alice (coord).
metering-bot: [automated] thread summary created: canary plan + telemetry fields + PR links.
